summary: Viking Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, announcing a CEO transition: Leah Talactac, previously President and CFO, was appointed CEO effective immediately; Torstein Hagen became Executive Chairman; and Linh Banh was appointed CFO. The changes are part of planned succession, not forced. The filing also included Q1 2026 financial results. No specific deal terms or advisor names were disclosed. The registrant is the issuer. This is a routine management succession event with no special-situation transaction. Watch for ongoing strategic continuity under the new leadership.
